meta.triageRationale: Small bugfix routed issue → build; localized existing Vibe mapper correction without new IPC or schema.

body.focus: Implement approved ISSUE-910fce32967bc4ea: correct Vibe programmatic prompt delivery for initial/resumed chat and title generation, preserving streaming, permissions, attachments and model environment; cover multiline and option-like prompts, verify real installed CLI contract without live inference and check backend stdin compatibility.
body.summary: Corrected Vibe programmatic prompt transport by binding the full text to --prompt= in the existing chat mapper, covering new/resumed turns and title generation. Streaming, attachment, permission and model environment behavior is retained; backend stdin transport remains unchanged. 152 affected tests and both typechecks passed locally. Installed Vibe 3.0.4 parser probe with a stub app server confirms old argv fails missing-prompt and corrected/multiline/backend stdin inputs pass that guard without inference. Authenticated live inference is a manual check.
